name: Generic Spine Protocol
description: Standardized quantitative spinal cord imaging protocol for multi-vendor 3.0T MRI systems. Based on the spine-generic protocol (Cohen-Adad et al., Nature Protocols 2021). Designed for cross-vendor compatibility (GE, Siemens, Philips) enabling reproducible quantitative spinal cord imaging across 42+ research sites.

T1-weighted 3D.description: High-resolution 3D T1-weighted structural imaging of the spinal cord
T1-weighted 3D.detailed_description:
## 3D T1-Weighted Structural Imaging

### Overview
The T1-weighted 3D acquisition provides high-resolution anatomical imaging of the spinal cord for morphometric analysis, tissue segmentation, and cross-sectional area measurements. Uses HCP-inspired parameters with 9° flip angle.

### Vendor-Specific Sequence Names
- **GE Healthcare:** BRAVO / IR-FSPGR
- **Siemens:** MPRAGE (Magnetization Prepared Rapid Gradient Echo)
- **Philips:** T1TFE (T1 Turbo Field Echo)

### Clinical Purpose
- Spinal cord cross-sectional area quantification
- Gray matter / white matter segmentation
- Anatomical reference for registration
- Structural lesion detection

### Key Parameters
- **Acquisition Type:** 3D volumetric
- **Target Resolution:** 1.0 mm isotropic
- **Coverage:** Full cervical spine (C1-C7)
- **Flip Angle:** 9° (HCP-inspired)
- **Inversion Time:** ~1000 ms
- **Scan Duration:** ~5 minutes

### Technical Notes
- Parallel imaging (GRAPPA/SENSE/ARC) factor: 2
- Inversion pulse preparation for enhanced GM/WM contrast
- Sagittal orientation optimized for spinal cord imaging
- TR varies by vendor: Siemens ~2000ms, Philips ~8ms, GE ~4ms (different TR definitions)

### Resources
- [Spine Generic Protocol (GitHub)](https://github.com/spine-generic/protocols)
- [Cohen-Adad et al. Nature Protocols 2021 (PDF)](https://github.com/spine-generic/protocols/blob/main/CohenAdad21_NatureProtocols.pdf)
- [Spine Generic Documentation](https://spine-generic.readthedocs.io/)
- [Importable Protocol Files](https://github.com/spine-generic/protocols/releases)

T2-weighted 3D.description: High-resolution 3D T2-weighted structural imaging with CSF suppression
T2-weighted 3D.detailed_description:
## 3D T2-Weighted Structural Imaging

### Overview
The T2-weighted 3D acquisition provides high-resolution imaging with excellent gray matter/white matter contrast and CSF signal suppression, optimized for spinal cord tissue characterization.

### Vendor-Specific Sequence Names
- **GE Healthcare:** CUBE (Cuboid Volume Acquisition)
- **Siemens:** SPACE (Sampling Perfection with Application optimized Contrasts using different flip angle Evolution)
- **Philips:** VISTA (Volume ISotropic Turbo spin echo Acquisition)

### Clinical Purpose
- Enhanced gray/white matter differentiation
- Lesion detection with T2 contrast
- Tissue microstructure assessment
- Complementary anatomical reference to T1w

### Key Parameters
- **Acquisition Type:** 3D volumetric
- **Target Resolution:** 0.8 mm isotropic
- **Coverage:** Cervical spine region
- **Echo Train Length:** 76-92
- **Scan Duration:** ~4-6 minutes

### Vendor Variations (expected)
- Siemens: TR = 1550 ms
- Philips: TR = 3500 ms
- GE: TR = 2507 ms

### Technical Notes
- Variable flip angle trains optimize signal across long echo trains
- Flow compensation in frequency direction reduces CSF pulsation artifacts
- Parallel imaging factor: 2-3 (vendor-dependent)
- Sagittal acquisition with high in-plane resolution

### Resources
- [Spine Generic Protocol (GitHub)](https://github.com/spine-generic/protocols)
- [Cohen-Adad et al. Nature Protocols 2021 (PDF)](https://github.com/spine-generic/protocols/blob/main/CohenAdad21_NatureProtocols.pdf)
- [Spine Generic Documentation](https://spine-generic.readthedocs.io/)
- [Importable Protocol Files](https://github.com/spine-generic/protocols/releases)

Diffusion-Weighted 2D.description: Cardiac-gated diffusion-weighted imaging for white matter microstructure assessment
Diffusion-Weighted 2D.detailed_description:
## 2D Diffusion-Weighted Imaging (DWI)

### Overview
Cardiac-gated diffusion-weighted imaging optimized for spinal cord white matter tract characterization using diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) analysis.

### Vendor-Specific Sequence Names
- **GE Healthcare:** SE-EPI with and without FOCUS
- **Siemens:** ep2d_diff with and without ZOOMit
- **Philips:** Zoom Diffusion (reduced FOV diffusion imaging)

### Clinical Purpose
- White matter tract integrity assessment via DTI metrics (FA, MD, RD, AD)
- Axonal damage quantification
- Fiber orientation mapping
- Microstructural tissue characterization

### Key Parameters
- **Acquisition Type:** 2D multi-slice
- **Gating:** Cardiac triggered (5 RR intervals)
- **Diffusion Scheme:** 30 directions + b=0 baseline
- **b-values:** 0, 800 s/mm²
- **Resolution:** 0.9×0.9×5.0 mm (BaseResolution=96)
- **TE:** 60-99 ms (varies with gradient strength: 40-80 mT/m)
- **Flip Angle:** 90°
- **Phase Encoding:** P-A (j-) in 94% of acquisitions
- **Scan Duration:** ~5-7 minutes (heart-rate dependent)

### Technical Notes
- **Cardiac Gating:** Critical for minimizing CSF pulsation artifacts
- **Reduced FOV Imaging:** Siemens ZOOMit, Philips Zoom Diffusion, GE FOCUS
- **TE Variations:** Protocol specifies "minimum TE" which varies by gradient strength
- **Partial Fourier:** 62-97% (typically ~75%)
- **Parallel Imaging:** Factor 2

### Resources
- [Spine Generic Protocol (GitHub)](https://github.com/spine-generic/protocols)
- [Cohen-Adad et al. Nature Protocols 2021 (PDF)](https://github.com/spine-generic/protocols/blob/main/CohenAdad21_NatureProtocols.pdf)
- [Spine Generic Documentation](https://spine-generic.readthedocs.io/)
- [Importable Protocol Files](https://github.com/spine-generic/protocols/releases)

rules.name: DWI b-value Check
rules.description: DWI should include b=0 and b=800 s/mm² acquisitions for DTI analysis.
rules.implementation:
b = sorted(float(x) for x in value["DiffusionBValue"].dropna().unique())
if not b:
    raise ValidationError("No DiffusionBValue found — is this a diffusion series?")

def parse_ranges(spec):
    ranges = []
    for part in [p.strip() for p in str(spec or "").split(",") if p.strip()]:
        lo_str, _, hi_str = part.partition("-")
        ranges.append((float(lo_str), float(hi_str) if hi_str else float(lo_str)))
    return ranges

found = [int(round(x)) for x in b]
missing = [f"{lo:g}-{hi:g}" for lo, hi in parse_ranges(params.get("required_ranges"))
           if not any(lo <= x <= hi for x in b)]
if missing:
    raise ValidationError(f"Missing required b-value range(s) {', '.join(missing)} s/mm². Found: {found}")
recommended = [f"{lo:g}-{hi:g}" for lo, hi in parse_ranges(params.get("recommended_ranges"))
              if not any(lo <= x <= hi for x in b)]
if recommended:
    raise ValidationWarning(f"Missing recommended b-value range(s) {', '.join(recommended)} s/mm². Found: {found}")

parameterDefinitions.name: required_ranges
parameterDefinitions.label: Required ranges
parameterDefinitions.description: Comma-separated 'lo-hi' b-value ranges (s/mm²) that must each contain at least one b-value

parameterDefinitions.name: recommended_ranges
parameterDefinitions.label: Recommended ranges
parameterDefinitions.description: Ranges that produce a warning when no b-value falls within them

parameterDefinitions.name: expected_axis

parameterDefinitions.description: Required InPlanePhaseEncodingDirection (COL = A-P axis, ROW = R-L axis)

parameterDefinitions.description: True for reversed polarity (e.g. P-A when the axis is COL), false for positive (e.g. A-P)

Multi-Echo GRE 2D.description: Multi-echo gradient echo imaging for T2* relaxometry and gray matter visualization
Multi-Echo GRE 2D.detailed_description:
## 2D Multi-Echo Gradient Recalled Echo (ME-GRE / T2star)

### Overview
Multi-echo gradient echo sequence designed for quantitative T2* mapping and gray matter characterization in the spinal cord.

### Vendor-Specific Sequence Names
- **GE Healthcare:** MERGE (Multiple Echo Recombined Gradient Echo)
- **Siemens:** GRE "medic" (Multi-Echo Data Image Combination)
- **Philips:** mFFE (multi Fast Field Echo)

### Clinical Purpose
- Quantitative T2* relaxometry
- Gray matter/white matter contrast via T2* differences
- Gray matter CSA quantification (relevant for ALS)
- Iron content assessment

### Key Parameters
- **Acquisition Type:** 2D multi-slice
- **Resolution:** 0.5×0.5×5.0 mm (BaseResolution=448)
- **Flip Angle:** 30°
- **TR:** 600-660 ms
- **Number of Echoes:** Multi-echo (typically 3-5)
- **Coverage:** Axial slices covering cervical cord
- **Scan Duration:** ~3-4 minutes

### Technical Notes
- **Anterior Saturation Band:** Critical feature to suppress swallowing artifacts
- **T2* Fitting:** Post-processing fits mono-exponential decay across echo times
- **Gray Matter Sensitivity:** T2* particularly sensitive to gray matter due to iron content

### Resources
- [Spine Generic Protocol (GitHub)](https://github.com/spine-generic/protocols)
- [Cohen-Adad et al. Nature Protocols 2021 (PDF)](https://github.com/spine-generic/protocols/blob/main/CohenAdad21_NatureProtocols.pdf)
- [Spine Generic Documentation](https://spine-generic.readthedocs.io/)
- [Importable Protocol Files](https://github.com/spine-generic/protocols/releases)

rules.name: Multi-Echo Validation
rules.description: The ME-GRE sequence should be a multi-echo acquisition (3+ echoes) for robust T2* fitting.

parameterDefinitions.name: min_echoes
parameterDefinitions.label: Minimum echoes
parameterDefinitions.description: Fail if fewer unique echoes than this

parameterDefinitions.name: recommended_echoes
parameterDefinitions.label: Recommended echoes
parameterDefinitions.description: Warn if fewer unique echoes than this (optional)

parameterDefinitions.name: exact_echoes
parameterDefinitions.label: Exact echoes
parameterDefinitions.description: Require exactly this many echoes (overrides min/recommended)

rules.name: ME-GRE Echo Spacing
rules.description: Echo spacing should be uniform for proper T2* fitting.
rules.implementation:
te = value["EchoTime"].dropna().sort_values()
spacings = te.diff().iloc[1:]
tol = params.get("tolerance_ms") or 0.1
if len(spacings) > 0 and not all(abs(spacings.iloc[0] - s) <= tol for s in spacings):
    raise ValidationError(f"Echo spacing not uniform (tolerance {tol} ms). Found spacings: {list(spacings.round(3))}.")

parameterDefinitions.name: tolerance_ms
parameterDefinitions.label: Tolerance
parameterDefinitions.description: Maximum allowed deviation between echo spacings

rules.name: ME-GRE High Resolution
rules.description: ME-GRE should have high in-plane resolution (~0.5mm) for gray matter visualization.

parameterDefinitions.label: Maximum in-plane spacing
parameterDefinitions.description: Fail if the mean in-plane pixel spacing exceeds this

Magnetization Transfer (MT on) 3D.description: Magnetization transfer imaging with MT saturation pulse ON for myelin quantification
Magnetization Transfer (MT on) 3D.detailed_description:
## 3D Gradient Echo with Magnetization Transfer ON (MTS-MTon)

### Overview
Three-dimensional gradient echo imaging with magnetization transfer (MT) saturation pulse enabled. This is one of three acquisitions required for calculating the magnetization transfer ratio (MTR) and MTsat.

### Vendor-Specific Sequence Names
- **GE Healthcare:** SPGR with MTC
- **Siemens:** GRE with MTC
- **Philips:** FFE with MTC

### Clinical Purpose
- **Myelin Quantification:** MTR is highly sensitive to myelin content
- **Demyelination Assessment:** Reduced MTR indicates myelin loss
- **Multiple Sclerosis:** Disease monitoring and progression tracking

### Key Parameters
- **Acquisition Type:** 3D volumetric
- **Resolution:** 0.9×0.9×5.0 mm
- **Flip Angle:** 9°
- **TR:** 35-108 ms (varies by platform due to SAR limits)
- **TE:** 2-4 ms (minimum)
- **MT Pulse:** ON (off-resonance saturation pulse)

### Vendor Variations (expected per protocol)
- Siemens: TR = 35.2 ms
- Philips: TR = 63.3 ms
- GE: TR = 50.3 ms

### Technical Notes
- Protocol explicitly states TR varies 5.4-8.9 min total acquisition due to platform-specific SAR limitations
- TR must match between MTon and MToff acquisitions
- If SAR limit reached, increase TR (e.g., 35ms to 36ms)

### Resources
- [Spine Generic Protocol (GitHub)](https://github.com/spine-generic/protocols)
- [Cohen-Adad et al. Nature Protocols 2021 (PDF)](https://github.com/spine-generic/protocols/blob/main/CohenAdad21_NatureProtocols.pdf)
- [Spine Generic Documentation](https://spine-generic.readthedocs.io/)
- [Importable Protocol Files](https://github.com/spine-generic/protocols/releases)

rules.name: MT Pulse Enabled
rules.description: MTon acquisition must have magnetization transfer pulse enabled (indicated in ScanOptions or SequenceVariant).
rules.implementation:
scan_options = str(value['ScanOptions'].iloc[0]) if 'ScanOptions' in value.columns else ''
seq_variant = str(value['SequenceVariant'].iloc[0]) if 'SequenceVariant' in value.columns else ''

if 'MT' not in scan_options.upper() and 'MTC' not in seq_variant.upper():
    raise ValidationError("MTon acquisition must have MT pulse enabled. Check ScanOptions or SequenceVariant for MT/MTC.")

Magnetization Transfer (MT off) 3D.description: Magnetization transfer imaging with MT saturation pulse OFF (baseline reference)
Magnetization Transfer (MT off) 3D.detailed_description:
## 3D Gradient Echo with Magnetization Transfer OFF (MTS-MToff)

### Overview
Baseline acquisition without MT saturation pulse, identical parameters to MTS-MTon except no MT pulse. Required for MTR calculation.

### Vendor-Specific Sequence Names
- **GE Healthcare:** SPGR (no MTC)
- **Siemens:** GRE (no MTC)
- **Philips:** FFE (no MTC)

### MTR Calculation
MTR = (MToff - MTon) / MToff × 100%

Typical values in healthy spinal cord:
- White matter: 34-35%
- Gray matter: 28-29%

### Key Parameters
- **Acquisition Type:** 3D volumetric
- **Resolution:** 0.9×0.9×5.0 mm
- **Flip Angle:** 9°
- **TR:** Must match MTon (35-108 ms)
- **TE:** 2-4 ms (minimum)
- **MT Pulse:** OFF (no saturation pulse)

### Technical Notes
- TR MUST match MTon acquisition for valid MTR calculation
- If SAR limit reached on MTon, also change TR on MToff to match

### Resources
- [Spine Generic Protocol (GitHub)](https://github.com/spine-generic/protocols)
- [Cohen-Adad et al. Nature Protocols 2021 (PDF)](https://github.com/spine-generic/protocols/blob/main/CohenAdad21_NatureProtocols.pdf)
- [Spine Generic Documentation](https://spine-generic.readthedocs.io/)
- [Importable Protocol Files](https://github.com/spine-generic/protocols/releases)

rules.name: MToff TR Must Match MTon
rules.description: TR for MToff acquisition MUST match MTon acquisition for valid MTR calculation. This cannot be automatically verified across acquisitions.
rules.implementation: raise ValidationWarning("MToff TR must match MTon TR for valid MTR calculation. Please manually verify that TR values are identical between MTon and MToff acquisitions.")

rules.name: MT Pulse Disabled
rules.description: MToff acquisition should NOT have MT pulse enabled.
rules.implementation:
scan_options = str(value['ScanOptions'].iloc[0]) if 'ScanOptions' in value.columns else ''
seq_variant = str(value['SequenceVariant'].iloc[0]) if 'SequenceVariant' in value.columns else ''

# Check that MTC is not in SequenceVariant (ScanOptions MT is less reliable)
if 'MTC' in seq_variant.upper():
    raise ValidationError("MToff acquisition should NOT have MT pulse enabled. Found MTC in SequenceVariant.")

Magnetization Transfer (T1-weighted) 3D.description: T1-weighted gradient echo for MTsat calculation (higher flip angle)
Magnetization Transfer (T1-weighted) 3D.detailed_description:
## 3D Gradient Echo T1-weighted for MTsat (MTS-T1w)

### Overview
T1-weighted gradient echo acquisition with higher flip angle (15°) used in combination with MTon and MToff to calculate MTsat, which partially compensates for B1+ inhomogeneity and T1 effects.

### Vendor-Specific Sequence Names
- **GE Healthcare:** SPGR
- **Siemens:** GRE
- **Philips:** FFE

### Clinical Purpose
- Required for MTsat calculation (more quantitative than MTR alone)
- B1+ inhomogeneity compensation
- T1 effect compensation

### MTsat Calculation
Requires: MT1 (MTon), MT0 (MToff), and T1w scans
- MTsat is more robust to B1 variations than MTR
- Provides better cross-site reproducibility

### Key Parameters
- **Acquisition Type:** 3D volumetric
- **Resolution:** 0.9×0.9×5.0 mm (BaseResolution=256)
- **Flip Angle:** 15° (different from MTon/MToff which use 9°)
- **TR:** 15-103 ms (varies by platform)
- **TE:** 2-4 ms (minimum)

### Vendor Variations
- Siemens: TR = 15.0 ms
- Philips: TR = 24.5 ms
- GE: TR = 15.7 ms

### Resources
- [Spine Generic Protocol (GitHub)](https://github.com/spine-generic/protocols)
- [Cohen-Adad et al. Nature Protocols 2021 (PDF)](https://github.com/spine-generic/protocols/blob/main/CohenAdad21_NatureProtocols.pdf)
- [Spine Generic Documentation](https://spine-generic.readthedocs.io/)
- [Importable Protocol Files](https://github.com/spine-generic/protocols/releases)
